meta.title: Travis Seah · Property Agent, Singapore
meta.description: Singapore property agent for HDB owners planning their next move. Clear numbers on your flat's value, your budget and your monthly cash flow before you decide.

hero.line1: I help families make their next property move.
hero.line2: But I'd rather you call me the agent who does the maths first.

approach.label: approach
approach.intro: Upgrading is two big decisions at once: selling your flat and buying your next home. Before we talk about listings, we work out whether it makes sense for your family at all.

steps.title: What is the next home for?
steps.text: A stable home to raise the family, or a way to build wealth over the next 5 to 10 years. The answer changes everything we look at.

steps.title: Your block, your numbers
steps.text: What flats near you have actually sold for, not a headline figure. Then your sale proceeds, CPF, loan and cash, added up honestly.

steps.title: The costs nobody mentions
steps.text: What you'd pay in cash each month once CPF no longer covers the mortgage, and the safety buffer you need if an income stops.

steps.title: Hold or upgrade, side by side
steps.text: Both options laid out so you and your partner can decide together, with no pressure either way.

approach.promise: If holding is the better choice for your family, I'll tell you.

work.label: work
work.intro: A few of the moves I've helped with. Details kept private for my clients.

items.title: The flat few buyers were allowed to buy
items.text: A multi-generation flat with an ethnic quota restriction, so the pool of eligible buyers was very small. We set honest expectations, stayed patient, and the right buyer came at the sellers' asking price.

items.title: Two families, two condos
items.text: Buyers guided from shortlist to keys, with the numbers checked at every step.

items.title: Three homes, three tenants
items.text: Condo leases matched with tenants and landlords.

about.label: about
about.heading: I listen first, then I bring the numbers.
paragraphs: I'm Travis, a property agent registered since 2025, working mainly with HDB owners deciding on their next move, whether that's selling, upgrading or holding.
Most people I meet don't need a sales pitch. They need someone to sit down with them, understand what their family actually wants, and show them clearly what each option costs.
And once we work together, you'll hear from me regularly, even on weeks with no viewings.
points: Updates even when there's no news

contact.label: contact
contact.heading: let's talk.
contact.text: Thinking about selling, upgrading or simply what your flat is worth? Send me a WhatsApp or give me a call. I reply personally.

footer.privacy: Your details are only used to reply to you. I won't add you to any list without your consent.
